   "hypothesis": "PROVENANCE track never ran. FRESH-ANGLES proposed five parallel tracks; Round 8 executed SEED, GEOMETRY, PAYLOAD, POINTERS, SKELETON. Track 5 (source PDF + rune-font identification: Ghostscript build fingerprint from DQT+ICC+geometry, hunt circulating PDFs with a real text layer, re-read the on-disk archived `onion7_index.html` for non-`.jpg` assets, match glyph outlines against stock runic faces) was never executed and appears in no results doc.",

threshold: Pre-registered in round18/L1-toolchain/PREREG.md before any run. (a) EXACT IJG QUALITY asserted only if interval-arithmetic inversion over libjpeg's temp=(base*scale+50)/100 rule admits exactly one integer quality consistent with all 64 luma AND all 64 chroma coefficients, and PC1 recovers 6/6 planted qualities. (b) ENCODER NAMED only if a control pipeline reproduces byte-identical DQT tables + identical Huffman-table classification + identical subsampling + identical component-count behaviour; anything less is written as 'consistent with'. (c) YEAR BOUND asserted only from a dated artefact inside the file, quoted verbatim. (d) FONT IDENTIFIED only if best candidate's mean per-glyph distance falls inside the PC3 degraded-self-match band AND beats the runner-up by >=2 sigma over >=20 rune classes.
